name: search_products
description: Search the grocery catalogue by one or two plain English words (pasta, tomato sauce, tuna). Returns at most 5 products, cheapest first, with code, name and price_usd.

query.description: one or two words for the product

no_palm_oil.description: true: only products whose ingredients hold no palm oil

max_price_usd.description: only products at or under this price

name: get_product
description: One product by its code: name, brand, quantity, price_usd, palm_oil, ingredients.

name: get_list
description: The shopper's shopping list with its total in USD.

name: add_to_list
description: Add one product to the shopper's shopping list. The shopper is asked to approve first.

request_id.description: set by the app, one per approved write; leave it empty
